title: Finite correlated equilibria and regret certificates
abstract: For finite games with player-specific action types, a valid independent product distribution is a correlated equilibrium exactly when its mixed profile is Nash. The correlated-equilibrium set is nonempty, compact, and convex when every player's action type is nonempty. For every positive finite horizon, cumulative external-regret and swap-regret bounds give corresponding approximate coarse-correlated and correlated equilibria of the empirical distribution. The development also proves equivalence with conditional obedience inequalities, arbitrary mixed-deviation sufficiency, and extension-by-zero correspondence for restricted legal actions. An exact per-recommendation certificate characterizes approximate correlated equilibrium without loss in its error budget and directly certifies empirical play from cumulative recommendation gains.
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
